 Payment Worksheet

 Pay the amount on line 8 on or before the return due date.

 2. Minimum payment rate  . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 2                       x .90

 3. Multiply line 1 by the rate on line 2 . . . . . . . 3

 4. Last year’s Utah tax liability (as filed,
    amended or audited) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 4
 5. Minimum tax due by original due date - 
    enter the lesser of line 3 or line 4 . . . . . . . . . 5
 6. This year’s Utah income tax withheld
    (forms W-2,1099, etc.) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 6

 7. Prepayments already made for this
    year,credit carryovers from prior years,
    and last year‘s refund applied to this year . . 7

 8. Minimum payment due
